headline: ScreenConnect rogue-client campaign widens to 288 endpoints; Wiz reports critical Apache HTTP Server RCE; Barracuda ESG KEV due 11-13

bullets.text: New: ScreenConnect attacks using rogue clients have reached at least 288 endpoints across 48 organizations, building on earlier reports of MSPs breached through ScreenConnect. N-central remains offline after a researcher published dozens of zero-days (6 outlets).

New: Wiz describes a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server, surfaced on Hacker News. The brief gives no fixed release; watch Apache httpd advisories and your distribution's packages.

KEV due 11-13: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (exploited, 4 outlets) and Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935. The 11-12 deadline for OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158, GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex has arrived.

Still exploited: critical Xen Orchestra flaws (3 outlets); Qlik Sense servers hit with reverse shells while attackers stage ActiveMQ and Veeam exploits; Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 and Openwave CVE-2026-111793 (KEV due 11-24).

Breaches and ransomware: Maersk confirmed a breach as WhiteArmor demands $5 million; Vanderbilt University on lockdown after ransomware (6 outlets); Credit Mutuel Arkea says €100m missing; Notion says a Fireworks breach exposed customer AI chat transcripts.

State and cloud activity: France blames Iran for sabotage of refrigeration controllers at about 700 retail sites (5 outlets); ESET links Cereal to Turla (5 outlets); AntiFox AI agents used to steal AWS credentials. Level holds at SITCON 3; week runs 1.06x the 90-day average.

actions: Inventory ScreenConnect instances, remove unknown or rogue clients, patch, and review session and access logs; keep N-central access restricted.
Identify internet-facing Apache HTTP Server hosts and be ready to patch as soon as a fixed release ships; restrict exposure meanwhile.
Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 by 11-13 and hunt for compromise; patch Ivanti Connect Secure.
Confirm OpenSSH, GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex patches are done; their KEV deadline was 11-12.
Keep Xen Orchestra off the internet; check Qlik Sense, ActiveMQ and Veeam servers for reverse shells and unexpected processes.
Review AWS keys and CloudTrail for unusual use; patch Outlook, Chrome, Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave by 11-24.
